errors.text_span: 第三个切片标记为“属性”，颜色为浅灰色，大约占20%。
errors.evidence: Figure shows “属性” is 16%, not about 20%.

errors.text_span: 第二个切片以紫灰色标记为“状态”，占约20%。第三个切片标记为“属性”，颜色为浅灰色，大约占20%。
errors.evidence: The chart shows “状态” as the light gray slice at 20% and “属性” as the medium gray slice at 16%; the description swaps their color mapping.
